$description: Cosmos 2.3.0 named motion motifs: the trigger, steps, allowed properties, duration, easing and per-tier and per-platform behaviour of every state change the system animates, with the sampled curve values a native port reproduces.
fetchWhen: animating a state change, on any platform
choosing between the tiers, or deciding whether a change animates at all
porting a transition to a native toolkit and proving curve parity

motifs.job: Tell the person that the thing they were tracking is now the thing they have.
motifs.trigger: A selection, fix or search resolves on a target the person was already watching.
steps: The glow scales past its resting size and settles back while its opacity resolves.
The ring resolves to its final angle with the glow.

tiers.full: Glow scale and ring angle both travel over the state duration.
tiers.reduced: Opacity only, over the feedback duration; the ring appears already at its final angle.
tiers.static: Glow and ring settle at once.

platforms.css: One keyframe set on a wrapper: transform for scale and angle, opacity for the glow.
platforms.compose: A single graphicsLayer animating scale and rotation; the glow is a separate layer so the two can differ in duration.
platforms.wear: The same two layers. Round geometry carries the ring; the arc length is the measured one, not a web constant.

motifs.settlesTo: The ring at its final angle and the glow at its resting opacity.

motifs.job: Show that a set arrived, in an order a person can follow down.
motifs.trigger: A list is populated for the first time, filtered, or reordered.
steps: Items enter along an arc, each offset from the one above it.
Each item resolves to opacity as it reaches its row.
The last item resolves; no item animates after that.

tiers.full: Items travel the arc, staggered by a fraction of the feedback duration each, within one feedback budget in total.
tiers.reduced: Opacity only, staggered, over the feedback duration.
tiers.static: The list is present at once, in its final order.

platforms.css: One animation-delay per index on a transform and opacity pair; the stagger is a custom property, never a per-row literal.
platforms.compose: A staggered reveal on the item layout; a LazyColumn does not animate its own content and must not be asked to.
platforms.wear: Never used on a watch list. A round screen has no arc to reveal along, and scrolling competes with the reveal for the same gesture.

motifs.settlesTo: Every item at its row, at full opacity, in the final order.

motifs.job: Carry time or progress across a wide surface without a spinner.
motifs.trigger: A timeline, countdown or long-running task advances to a new reading.
steps: A band translates across the horizon gradient, leaving the previous reading behind it.
The band resolves at the position the stored reading gives it.

tiers.full: The band travels over the context duration.
tiers.reduced: The band is placed at its final position and its opacity resolves over the feedback duration; no travel.
tiers.static: The band is placed at its final position.

platforms.css: A gradient overlay inside overflow:hidden, moved with transform so the horizon itself is never repainted.
platforms.compose: A translated overlay layer; the gradient is a brush on the parent, not an animated shader.
platforms.wear: Never used on a watch. There is no horizon band wide enough to sweep, and a travelling element on a round screen reads as a second hand.

motifs.settlesTo: The band at the position of the stored reading, with the earlier reading no longer drawn.

motifs.job: Move context forward one step, so the person always knows which step they are on.
motifs.trigger: The context spine advances from the current step to the next one.
steps: The outgoing step resolves to inactive.
The incoming step resolves to active.
The connector between them fills to its new length.

tiers.full: The outgoing and incoming steps cross-resolve and the connector grows over the state duration.
tiers.reduced: The connector is placed at its final length and the two steps cross-resolve in opacity over the feedback duration.
tiers.static: The step and the connector are set together, with no cross-resolve.

platforms.css: Transform on the connector so growth is a scale rather than a width; opacity on the two labels.
platforms.compose: A scaleX on the connector inside a fixed-width track; labels cross-fade.
platforms.wear: One step at a time. The spine is the round bezel: the connector is the bezel arc and only the active step label changes.

motifs.settlesTo: The incoming step active, the outgoing step inactive, the connector at its final length.

motifs.job: Show which context a layer came from, and leave it dismissible.
motifs.trigger: A sheet, dialog or popover is presented over the current context.
steps: The surface travels in from the edge it is anchored to.
The drag or close affordance resolves with the surface, never after it.

tiers.full: Scrim and surface travel together over the state duration; dismissal uses the departure purpose.
tiers.reduced: The scrim resolves over the feedback duration and the surface is presented at its resting offset.
tiers.static: The surface is presented at its resting offset with the scrim at its resting opacity. It is still a dismissible layer with a real close target.

platforms.css: A dialog element and its backdrop, transformed rather than resized, with the surface kept inside the viewport on every breakpoint.
platforms.compose: A ModalBottomSheet or Dialog; the sheet does its own scrim and must not be given a second one.
platforms.wear: A single full-bleed layer. A bottom sheet on a round screen covers the bezel, so the watch presents its surface as a replacement view with a back target instead.

motifs.settlesTo: The surface at its resting offset, the scrim at its resting opacity, dismissal still available.

motifs.job: Say that a reading is no longer fresh, without asking for attention.
motifs.trigger: A stored reading falls outside its freshness window.
steps: The reading resolves to the dimmed treatment.
The stale label appears with the reading, and is the only new element.

tiers.full: The dim resolves over the feedback duration. It runs once.
tiers.reduced: The dim resolves over the feedback duration, opacity only, once.
tiers.static: The reading is presented dimmed with its label.

platforms.css: An opacity step on the reading, plus a class or attribute that reveals the label. The label is never cross-faded into place.
platforms.compose: An alpha change on the reading container, and the label as a sibling so its content is present for assistive technology from the first frame.
platforms.wear: Dimming only. A watch reading carries no label, because there is no room for one beside a value; the staleness is stated in the detail view instead.

motifs.settlesTo: The reading dimmed, with its stale label present.
constraints: Never a pulse, a blink, a loop or a repeat. A reading that has gone stale has not become more urgent, and attention-pulsing a stored value inverts C21.
The dim is opacity on the reading. The label is inserted, not animated, so a stale reading is never briefly readable as a fresh one.

motifs.job: Carry the reader from one context to the next without losing the frame.
motifs.trigger: A route change resolves to a different context.
steps: The outgoing context resolves out on the departure purpose.
The incoming context arrives on the arrival purpose.
Any shared spine advances on its own motif, not on this timeline.

tiers.full: Outgoing and incoming run on the context duration, in opposite directions.
tiers.reduced: Both resolve in opacity over the feedback duration, with no travel.
tiers.static: The incoming context is presented at once.

platforms.css: Two cross-resolving layers inside a stable frame; the route does not scroll, and a back navigation runs the same motif in reverse.
platforms.compose: A shared NavHost frame whose outgoing and incoming composables cross-resolve; the host owns the duration so a screen cannot pick its own.
platforms.wear: A replacement view with the back target always visible. Cross-fading two contexts on a round screen hides the bezel that carries the gesture.

motifs.settlesTo: The incoming context at rest, the outgoing one gone, focus and scroll at the incoming context own values.

algorithm: For each published curve, sample x from 0 to 1 in equal steps of 1 / (count - 1).
x(t) = 3(1-t)²t·x1 + 3(1-t)t²·x2 + t³, and the same form with y1, y2 for y(t). P0 is (0,0) and P3 is (1,1), so their terms drop out.
Bisect t on [0, 1] a fixed number of iterations, keeping the half where x(t) is below x, and evaluate y(t) at the final midpoint.
Publish y to six decimal places. The endpoints are 0 and 1 exactly; every sample is monotonic non-decreasing.

timing.settlesTo: The ring at its final angle and the glow at its resting opacity.
Every item at its row, at full opacity, in the final order.
The band at the position of the stored reading, with the earlier reading no longer drawn.
The incoming step active, the outgoing step inactive, the connector at its final length.
The surface at its resting offset, the scrim at its resting opacity, dismissal still available.
The reading dimmed, with its stale label present.
The incoming context at rest, the outgoing one gone, focus and scroll at the incoming context own values.
